rules.audit_note: CE must be reported to the Department of Health CE tracking system (MQA Online account, 'Report CE/CME') before renewing.
rules.accepted_credit_types: ADA or national dental associations; Florida Dental Association; AGD; ADHA and components; CODA-accredited schools; accredited hospitals/colleges; AHA, Red Cross, American Cancer Society; AMA; Board-approved providers listed in CE Broker
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: only 2 h prescribing of controlled substances and 2 h HIV/AIDS.

rules.notes: All licenses expire Feb 28, 2028 (previous: Feb 28, 2026). Current live/hands-on BLS-level CPR required (does not count toward hours). Sedation permit holders: 4 h management of medical emergencies incl. airway. Fee $305 active renewal (+ permit fees).
